job.value: Understand why the listing was removed and fix or appeal it

arrivedFrom.value: A removal notification or the removed listing

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Listing removed' with the item and a red 'Removed' tag says straight away what happened.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width teal 'Appeal' is the most prominent element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Appeal' is clear, but 'Mark past listing as active' doesn't say which listing it means or what happens to the removed one.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Violation details' gives only 'You've listed a similar listing in the past' and never names the rule (duplicate listings).

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The seller must choose between 'Appeal' and 'Mark past listing as active' without being told the rule they broke or what each option leads to.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Rule detail is behind 'Listing Rules' and 'Contact support' links.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything on screen is about the removal and how to resolve it.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Two buttons and two item cards carry it; the text is two short lines.
